full_public_headers.header:
structure PositiveChartRangeGeometry
    (F G : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) (h : PolarPoint → ℝ)
    (l r u v : ℝ) : Prop

full_public_headers.name: PositiveChartRangeGeometry.bijOn
full_public_headers.header:
theorem PositiveChartRangeGeometry.bijOn
    {F G : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {h : PolarPoint → ℝ} {l r u v : ℝ}
    (H : PositiveChartRangeGeometry F G h l r u v) :
    BijOn F (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) (Ioo u v ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))

full_public_headers.name: PositiveChartRangeGeometry.inverse_germs
full_public_headers.header:
theorem PositiveChartRangeGeometry.inverse_germs
    {F G : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {h : PolarPoint → ℝ} {l r u v : ℝ}
    (H : PositiveChartRangeGeometry F G h l r u v) (p : PolarPoint) :
    CanonicalBoundaryInverseGerm F G p ∧ CanonicalBoundaryInverseGerm G F p

full_public_headers.name: PositiveChartRangeGeometry.boundary_fields
full_public_headers.header:
theorem PositiveChartRangeGeometry.boundary_fields
    {F G : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {h : PolarPoint → ℝ} {l r u v : ℝ}
    (H : PositiveChartRangeGeometry F G h l r u v) (hlr : l < r) :
    MapsTo F (closure (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))) (Icc u v ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) ∧
    MapsTo G (Icc u v ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) (closure (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ closure (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)), G (F p) = p) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ Icc u v ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ), F (G p) = p) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ closure (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)),
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F p ∧ ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ h p ∧
      planeJacobian F p ≠ 0 ∧ 0 < h p) ∧
    (∀ p ∈ frontier (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)),
      CanonicalBoundaryInverseGerm F G p)

full_public_headers.name: PositiveChartRangeGeometry.jacobian_even
full_public_headers.header:
theorem PositiveChartRangeGeometry.jacobian_even
    {F G : PolarPoint → PolarPoint} {h : PolarPoint → ℝ} {l r u v : ℝ}
    (H : PositiveChartRangeGeometry F G h l r u v) (p : PolarPoint) :
    planeJacobian F (p.1, -p.2) = planeJacobian F p

full_public_headers.name: positiveReferenceCylinder_rangeGeometry
full_public_headers.header:
theorem positiveReferenceCylinder_rangeGeometry
    {Y H : ℝ → ℝ} {l r u v : ℝ}
    (hY : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y) (hYpos : ∀ x, 0 < deriv Y x)
    (hYbij : Function.Bijective Y) (hYinv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Function.invFun Y))
    (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H) (hHpos : ∀ x, 0 < H x)
    (hleft : Y l = u) (hright : Y r = v) :
    PositiveChartRangeGeometry (positiveReferenceCylinderChart Y)
      (positiveReferenceCylinderInverse Y) (fun p : PolarPoint => H p.1) l r u v

full_public_headers.name: divergenceOperator_radial_height_of_coefficient_germs
full_public_headers.header:
theorem divergenceOperator_radial_height_of_coefficient_germs
    {A : SymmetricCoefficients} {w H : ℝ → ℝ} {p : PolarPoint}
    (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H)
    (ha : A.a =ᶠ[𝓝 p] (fun q : PolarPoint => w q.1))
    (hb : A.b =ᶠ[𝓝 p] (fun _ : PolarPoint => (0 : ℝ))) :
    divergenceOperator A (fun q : PolarPoint => H q.1) p =
      deriv (fun r => w r * deriv H r) p.1

full_public_headers.name: inverseChartPotential_radial_cylinder
full_public_headers.header:
theorem inverseChartPotential_radial_cylinder
    {A : SymmetricCoefficients} {w Y H : ℝ → ℝ} {p : PolarPoint}
    (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H)
    (hY : DifferentiableAt ℝ Y (Function.invFun Y p.1))
    (hYpos : 0 < deriv Y (Function.invFun Y p.1))
    (ha : A.a =ᶠ[𝓝 (positiveReferenceCylinderInverse Y p)]
      (fun q : PolarPoint => w q.1))
    (hb : A.b =ᶠ[𝓝 (positiveReferenceCylinderInverse Y p)]
      (fun _ : PolarPoint => (0 : ℝ))) :
    inverseChartPotential A (positiveReferenceCylinderChart Y)
      (positiveReferenceCylinderInverse Y) (fun q : PolarPoint => H q.1) p =
        H (Function.invFun Y p.1) *
          deriv (fun r => w r * deriv H r) (Function.invFun Y p.1) /
            deriv Y (Function.invFun Y p.1)
